message: Stepping out onto the sandy beach, I involuntarily squinted against the dazzling sunlight.
I was completely and defenselessly overwhelmed by the glittering blue waves as well.

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san! Hurry up and come over here!」
Taking the hand of Melilot-san, who was timidly following behind me, I led her to the water's edge.

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be cool once you get in the ocean.」
As promised, we had come on a trip to a tropical beach.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it is the ocean, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, that's what the swimsuit is for.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't... stare at me so much...」
She's right in front of me, so of course I'm going to see her, or rather...
It'd be a waste not to look right now!

name: Synn
message: 「Look, take a good look! They're totally normal, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I told you, please don't stare at me like that...」
Well, if staring is out, I'll just sneak glances instead.

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't let go of my hand...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay. I won't let go, I promise.」

name: Synn
message: 「More importantly, what do you think of the ocean?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Aah... It feels kind of strange, doesn't it...」
A huge wave came and swallowed Melilot-san up.
Did she hit her head when she went down or something?

name: Melilot
message: 「It was a little salty, and it surprised me too, but...」

name: Melilot
message: 「The ocean is so much fun, isn't it?」
More than the pouring sunlight, and more than the glare off the water's surface.......
Melilot-san's crystal-clear smile looked more dazzling than anything else.
The seawater Melilot-san scooped up hits me right in the face.

name: Melilot
message: 「You suddenly pulled me into the ocean, didn't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You startled me, so this is payback!」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's how you want to play, take this!」
Before I knew it, it seemed Melilot-san had gotten used to the ocean, too.
The two of us scoop up water, splashing around as we chase each other.
Once again, a wave breaks with a splash and vanishes right at Melilot-san's feet.
Splashing droplets sparkle brightly against her fine, fair skin.
The clear dripping water droplets, looking just like tiny fruits.

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all--as long as you enjoyed yourself, Melilot, that's what matters most.」

name: Synn
message: 「From now on, let's go to many, many more places together.」

name: Synn
message: 「Far, far away, until there aren't any places left that we don't know!」
As long as I'm with Melilot, there's nothing to feel uneasy about at all.
As long as the two of us are together, we should be able to do anything.
I wonder just how far we'll be able to go...
Let's find out together, the two of us.
